sprints.name: Sprint 1: Authentication Foundation
sprints.goal: Establish basic authentication infrastructure with JWT tokens and email/password login

notes: JWT implementation went smoothly using jsonwebtoken library
Database schema included provisions for OAuth data (for future sprints)
Password hashing uses bcrypt with 10 salt rounds (industry standard)
Login endpoint includes rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks

technicalDecisions.reasoning: Most popular, well-maintained, supports all required features
Industry standard, slow by design (prevents brute force)
Allows token revocation and session management

delivered: Working JWT token generation with 15min access token, 7day refresh token
User registration endpoint with email validation
Login endpoint with rate limiting (5 attempts per 15min)
Logout endpoint that invalidates refresh tokens
Password hashing utilities with 10 salt rounds
tested: Unit tests for JWT utilities (10 tests, all passing)
Integration tests for auth endpoints (15 tests, all passing)
Manual testing of full registration → login → logout flow

lessonsLearned: Including rate limiting from the start prevented security issues
Storing refresh tokens in DB adds complexity but necessary for security
Need to add email verification in next sprint (currently accepts any email)
nextSprintRecommendations: Implement email verification to prevent fake accounts
Add OAuth2 for better user experience
